---
title: "Which proteins change after a 15 min PASN pulse?"
subtitle: "Bio253 HS2026 · group: 15min (names: simona_michelle) · protein part"
---

Follow-up of notebook 07. Notebook 07 showed *how many* proteins change after
15 min of PASN (35 of 2003 reliable proteins, 1.7 %). This notebook looks at
*which* proteins they are and *how* they behave.

```{r setup}
source("../R/setup.R")
```

## 1. Question

*Which proteins of* S. aureus *JE2 (wild type, anc) change after a 15 min PASN
pulse, what are their functions, and do these changes persist after ~15 h of
PASN exposure?*

## 2. Hypothesis

*Suggestion, adapt it before you look at the results:*

* **H1:** The proteins that change after 15 min are mainly fermentation /
  anaerobic-metabolism proteins and they go **up**, consistent with PASN
  components (e.g. HQNO) blocking respiration. Most of these changes are still
  present after ~15 h (sustained).
* **H0:** The early-changed proteins are not dominated by one functional group,
  and their changes are not maintained at ~15 h.
* **Prediction:**
  * Contrasts: `TSB_vs_SNpulse_at_anc` (15 min) and `TSB_vs_SN_at_anc` (~15 h)
  * Fermentation proteins with `diff < 0` (= higher after PASN)
  * "Changed": FDR < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1 (same as notebook 07)

```{r contrast-meaning}
# diff = log2(TSB) - log2(PASN): diff < 0 means HIGHER after PASN
explain_contrast("TSB_vs_SNpulse_at_anc")
```

## 3. Data used

* **Tables:** total proteome, course DEA (`dea_total`, prolfquapp, vsn) and
  per-sample normalised abundances (`abundances_total`, log2);
  for section 5.6 also the phosphosite DEA (`dea_phospho_STYH`)
* **Samples:** wild type (anc) only: TSB, SNpulse (15 min), SN (~15 h); n = 3 per group
* **Filters (identical to notebook 07):**
  * contaminants removed (default of `read_dea()` / `read_abundances()`)
  * **reliable** = detected in ≥ 2 of 3 replicates in both compared groups
    **and** `estimate_type == "observed"` (no imputed group mean)
  * **changed** = FDR < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1
* The mutants (`stk`, `stp`) are not included for now. To add them later, add
  e.g. `TSB_vs_SNpulse_at_stk` to `contr`; the flags below work for them too.

```{r data}
contr <- c("TSB_vs_SNpulse_at_anc", "TSB_vs_SN_at_anc")

dea <- read_dea("total", contrasts = contr)
ab  <- read_abundances("total")

# How many of the 3 replicates have a value, per protein, genotype and medium
n_obs <- ab |>
  group_by(protein_key, genotype, medium) |>
  summarise(n = sum(!is.na(normalized_abundance)), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(genotype = as.character(genotype)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = medium, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

dea <- dea |>
  # genotype = last part of the contrast name ("..._at_anc"); time from the medium
  mutate(genotype = str_extract(contrast, "(anc|stk|stp)$"),
         time     = if_else(str_detect(contrast, "SNpulse"), "15 min", "15 h")) |>
  left_join(n_obs, by = c("protein_key", "genotype")) |>
  mutate(reliable = if_else(time == "15 min",
                            TSB >= 2 & SNpulse >= 2,
                            TSB >= 2 & SN >= 2),
         reliable  = coalesce(reliable, FALSE) & estimate_type == "observed",
         changed   = FDR < 0.05 & abs(diff) > 1,
         direction = if_else(diff < 0, "higher after PASN", "lower after PASN"))

# Sanity check: must give 35 changed proteins at 15 min, like notebook 07
dea |> filter(reliable) |> count(contrast, changed)

# The early-changed proteins (wild type, 15 min) - used in all of section 5
early <- dea |>
  filter(contrast == "TSB_vs_SNpulse_at_anc", reliable, changed) |>
  mutate(fold_change = round(2^abs(diff), 1)) |>   # log2 -> "x-fold"
  select(protein_key, locus_tag, product, staa8_uniprot, staa8_gene,
         diff, fold_change, direction, FDR) |>
  arrange(diff)                                      # strongest increase first
```

## 4. Methods

* Same course DEA and the same reliable/changed rules as notebook 07, so the
  35 proteins are identical.
* **List (5.2):** all early-changed proteins with fold change (2^|log2FC|),
  direction in words and UniProt ID of the NCTC8325 ortholog; saved as CSV.
* **Functional groups (5.3):** first automatic guess from keywords in the product
  name, then corrected by hand after checking UniProt.
* **15 min vs ~15 h (5.4):** for each early protein, the change at ~15 h was
  classified as *sustained* (changed, same direction), *reversed* (changed,
  opposite direction), *transient* (not changed) or *not reliable at 15 h*.
* **On/off proteins (5.5):** proteins detected in 3/3 replicates in one medium
  and 0/3 in the other; reported as presence/absence, without a fold change.
* **Phosphosites (5.6):** STYH sites on the early proteins (course phospho DEA).
* *AI: what did you check yourself (e.g. the 35 match notebook 07, raw values,
  contrast direction, UniProt lookups)?*

## 5. Results

### 5.1 Raw values first

```{r raw-values}
# The 6 proteins with the strongest change (largest |log2FC|)
top6 <- early |> slice_max(abs(diff), n = 6) |> pull(protein_key)
plot_protein(top6, filter(ab, genotype == "anc"))
```

*All replicates present? Any outliers?*

### 5.2 The list of early-changed proteins

```{r early-list}
early |> select(-protein_key)
early |> count(direction)
```

```{r save-list}
# A result table (not raw data): may go to GitHub; Michelle can join it with her sites
write_csv(early, file.path(REPO_ROOT, "reports", "15min_changed_proteins_anc.csv"))
```

*Look up the most interesting ones in UniProt (`staa8_uniprot`) and note their function.*

### 5.3 Functional groups

The automatic categories are only a starting point: product names can be vague
("hypothetical protein"). Check in UniProt and correct them in `manual`.

```{r categories}
early <- early |>
  mutate(category = case_when(
    str_detect(product, regex("alcohol dehydrogenase|lactate|formate|pyruvate|acetaldehyde",
                              ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "fermentation",
    str_detect(product, regex("anaerobic|nitrate|nitrite",
                              ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "anaerobic metabolism",
    str_detect(product, regex("transglycosylase|autolysin|amidase|endopeptidase|peptidoglycan|cell wall|cell division",
                              ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "cell wall / division",
    str_detect(product, regex("toxin|hemolysin|leukocidin",
                              ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "toxins / virulence",
    str_detect(product, regex("cold-shock|heat shock|stress",
                              ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "stress response",
    str_detect(product, regex("transporter|ABC|permease|uptake",
                              ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "transport",
    str_detect(product, regex("hypothetical|uncharacteri[sz]ed|DUF",
                              ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "unknown function",
    .default = "other (check UniProt)"))

# Your corrections after reading UniProt: one row per protein you re-assign
manual <- tibble::tribble(
  ~locus_tag,     ~category_manual,
  "B7H15_00000",  "example (delete this row)"
)

early <- early |>
  left_join(manual, by = "locus_tag") |>
  mutate(category = coalesce(category_manual, category)) |>
  select(-category_manual)

early |>
  ggplot(aes(y = category, fill = direction)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("higher after PASN" = "#D55E00",
                               "lower after PASN"  = "#0072B2")) +
  labs(x = "number of proteins", y = NULL, fill = NULL,
       title = "Early-changed proteins (wild type, 15 min PASN)")
```

*Is fermentation / anaerobic metabolism the biggest group (H1)? Which groups go up, which down?*

### 5.4 15 min vs ~15 h: sustained or transient?

```{r time-compare}
time_cmp <- dea |>
  filter(genotype == "anc", protein_key %in% early$protein_key) |>
  select(protein_key, locus_tag, product, time, diff, reliable, changed) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = c(diff, reliable, changed)) |>
  mutate(pattern = case_when(
    !`reliable_15 h`                                          ~ "not reliable at 15 h",
    `changed_15 h` & sign(`diff_15 h`) == sign(`diff_15 min`) ~ "sustained",
    `changed_15 h`                                            ~ "reversed",
    .default                                                  = "transient"))

time_cmp |> count(pattern)

time_cmp |>
  ggplot(aes(`diff_15 min`, `diff_15 h`, colour = pattern)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +   # same change at both times
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = locus_tag), size = 2.3, vjust = -0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(sustained = "#D55E00", transient = "#0072B2",
                                 reversed = "#CC79A7",
                                 "not reliable at 15 h" = "grey60")) +
  labs(x = "log2FC at 15 min (< 0 = higher after PASN)",
       y = "log2FC at ~15 h (< 0 = higher in PASN)",
       title = "Early-changed proteins: 15 min vs ~15 h (wild type)")
```

How to read it: **lower left** = up at both times; near the **horizontal
0-line** = changed at 15 min, back to normal at 15 h; below the dashed diagonal
= changed even more at 15 h.

*Which pattern dominates? Name 2–3 example proteins with numbers.*

### 5.5 On/off proteins (excluded from the counts)

Detected in all 3 replicates in one medium and in none of the other.
**Presence/absence evidence only**: no reliable fold change.

```{r on-off}
on_off <- n_obs |>
  filter(genotype == "anc") |>
  mutate(pattern = case_when(
    TSB == 3 & SNpulse == 0 ~ "only in TSB (lost after PASN)",
    TSB == 0 & SNpulse == 3 ~ "only after PASN (appears)",
    .default = NA)) |>
  filter(!is.na(pattern)) |>
  left_join(select(read_annotation(), protein_key, locus_tag, product, staa8_uniprot),
            by = "protein_key")

on_off |> count(pattern)
on_off |> select(pattern, locus_tag, product, staa8_uniprot, TSB, SNpulse, SN)

if (nrow(on_off) > 0) plot_protein(head(on_off$protein_key, 6), filter(ab, genotype == "anc"))
```

*How many? Are they close to the detection limit? Do they fit the groups from 5.3?*

### 5.6 Do the early proteins carry phosphosites?

```{r phospho-link}
phos_early <- read_dea("phospho_STYH", contrasts = "TSB_vs_SNpulse_at_anc") |>
  filter(protein_key %in% early$protein_key) |>
  select(locus_tag, product, residue, position, diff, FDR, estimate_type) |>
  arrange(locus_tag, position)

n_distinct(phos_early$locus_tag)   # how many of the 35 have >= 1 phosphosite
phos_early
```

*A site on a protein that went up also looks "up" (more protein = more
phosphopeptide): compare site and protein `diff` (combined notebook, 5.3).
Agree with Michelle on the rule (≥ 2/3 or ≥ 1/3).*

## 6. Caveats

*Fill in what applies, e.g.:*

* *Only 3 replicates; FDR sensitive to single outlying samples.*
* *Categories from product names / UniProt are approximate; many "hypothetical proteins".*
* *15 h is not just a longer pulse: SN cells grew ~15 h in a different, partly
  nutrient-depleted medium (notebook 07, caveat 1).*
* *On/off proteins have no fold change; they may be close to the detection limit.*
* *Protein abundance ≠ activity (e.g. enzymes can be regulated by phosphorylation).*

## 7. Conclusion and next steps

*Answer your question in 2–3 sentences: which kinds of proteins change first,
in which direction, and do the changes persist at ~15 h? Is H1 supported?
What would you do next (e.g. the mutants)?*
